data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Greedy insertion of a 13th channel into optimal 12-input networks cannot yield a network of size < 45, because optimal 12-input networks are structurally rigid, requiring at least 7 additional comparators (yielding 46) when extended to 13 inputs, explaining why search stalls at 45 for de novo 13-input constructions.","counterconditions":[{"case":"A specific 12-input optimal network can be extended with exactly 6 comparators to sort 13 inputs.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"A different insertion strategy bypasses the rigidity and yields a 45-comparator network.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Optimal 12-input networks are maximally packed.
